projectName.description: Project name. If omitted, defaults to the current working directory's name (sanitized: non-alphanumeric characters replaced with '-').

spec.description: Path to the base spec.ive.yaml. Defaults to 'spec.ive.yaml' if omitted.

activeGenerations.description: Names of the generations (keys of 'generations') to run by default when no specific generation is passed via CLI. Can be empty right after 'ive init' — nothing to generate yet, not structurally invalid.

generations.description: Map of generation name -> its configuration. Can be empty right after 'ive init'.

verifications.description: LAS GENERACIONES DE PRUEBAS, que parten de los escenarios de flow y de los casos de mapeo que produjo la simulacion, no de la especificacion. MISMA FORMA QUE `generations` Y OTRA CLAVE, a proposito: si vivieran ahi, alguien las agrega a `activeGenerations` y a partir de entonces se corren en cada vuelta, tocando archivos que llevan lo que una persona escribio. No entran por `activeGenerations`: se corren con `ive verify generate`. Ver `ive-docs/generacion-desde-escenarios.md`.

specification.description: QUIEN es el proveedor: el `specification.id` de su spec. Es la identidad ESTABLE de la dependencia -- `adapterSource` dice donde esta el archivo HOY, en esta maquina, y eso cambia con cada checkout. Sin esto, si el archivo no esta no se sabe ni de que servicio se trata; y si apunta al archivo equivocado nadie lo nota, porque los dos son adapters validos. Declarado, se compara contra el `specificationId` que el propio adapter trae: si no coinciden, se esta generando contra el contrato de otro servicio. Es el mismo id con el que Facts cruza el grafo de consumo (`provider_specification_id`).

adapterSource.description: Path or URL to an adapter-sdk.json this dependency resolves to. DONDE esta ahora; quien es lo dice `specification`.

project.description: El proyecto vinculado (ver 'projects') del que sale esta dependencia. Vincular y depender son dos momentos de la MISMA relacion: vincular apunta a la especificacion --lo que hace falta para ESCRIBIR el flow-- y depender al adapter ya generado --lo que hace falta para MATERIALIZAR la llamada--. Este campo es el que las une, y por eso el origen remoto se declara una sola vez, en 'projects', y no por dependencia.

dependencies.description: Map of dependency name (referenced from the spec) -> where to load its adapter-sdk.json from (local path or URL).

projects.description: Map of linked project name -> where that project lives. The path is relative to this config file. A flow step can reference an Intent of a linked project with $ref: <path>/spec.ive.yaml#/intents/Name; the resolver imports it at generation time. Declaring it here is what lets tooling offer those Intents and their fields instead of having the path typed by hand.

path.description: Directory of the linked project, relative to this config file. Relativa a proposito: un proyecto se clona en cualquier lado y la ruta absoluta de una maquina no vale en la otra.

from.description: DE DONDE se obtiene este proyecto cuando no esta al lado -- en una organizacion viven en repositorios distintos, y una ruta relativa solo sirve si alguien ya los puso uno junto al otro. EL GENERADOR NO LO RESUELVE NI BAJA NADA: salir a la red a mitad de una generacion haria que el resultado dependa del momento. Es para quien prepara el entorno, y para que el error diga que falta y de donde sacarlo, en vez de un ENOENT con una ruta.

repository.description: URL del repositorio donde vive el proyecto.

ref.description: Tag, rama o commit. Sin esto, 'el repositorio' no identifica una version: manana dice otra cosa.

path.description: Subcarpeta dentro del repositorio, cuando no esta en la raiz.

spec.description: Spec file inside that directory. Defaults to spec.ive.yaml.

outputDirectory.description: Project-wide default output root. Individual generations can override this.

vars.description: Custom variables, substituted like {projectName} in fileName/fileNamePattern/outputDirectory/relativePath/templateRoots. Cannot contain a key literally named 'projectName' (reserved).

oneOf.description: A single path or URL to a platform catalog file (legacy form).
Multiple paths/URLs to platform catalog files, concatenated with the ones from the system config.

basePath.description: Prepended to each entry in 'files' unless that entry is already a full URL or an absolute path.

oneOf.description: {basePath, files} form — same mechanism used by the system config's own platformCatalog.

platformCatalog.description: Path(s) or URL(s) to the platform catalog (Envelope requirements/errors/profiles), used to infer/validate errors from Envelope requirements. Concatenated with the system config's own list, never overrides it. Same local-or-remote mechanism as dependencies.adapterSource.

config.description: Override of the validation schema used for ive.config.json itself.

specification.description: Override of the validation schema used for spec.ive.yaml.

overlay.description: Override of the validation schema used for overlays.

schemas.description: Per-artifact-type (config/specification/overlay) override of which validation schema to use. Overrides the system config's registry entry-by-entry — whatever isn't declared here still comes from there.

expandOverlayRefs.description: If true, expands $refs added by overlays inline.

resolveSpecRefs.description: If false, does NOT expand $refs from the base spec.

extends.description: Path to a base generation config (YAML/JSON) to deep-merge with this one.

source.description: Overrides the input source for this generation (defaults to the project's base spec).

templateRoots.description: Template repositories to load, in cascade order (later roots override same-named helpers from earlier ones).

overlays.description: Overlay names/paths to apply, in order. A bare name (no extension) resolves to '<configDir>/overlays/<name>.ive.yaml'; a name with any extension is used as-is.

outputDirectory.description: Root output directory for this generation. Supports {projectName} and any declared 'vars' key.

requiredVars.description: Variables the project must declare for THIS generation to produce something correct. Checked before anything is written. It exists because the mechanism that detects missing vars only sees the CONFIGURATION: a var a template reads as `vars.<x>` is invisible to it, and when such a var is missing nothing fails - a folder comes out literally named `{theVar}`, or a .java with an empty package. Declared here and not in technology.yaml because descriptors load from templateRoots and the backend chain is a SUBSET of the SDK one: no repo tells them apart.

kind.description: What shape the value must have. Checked up front, so a malformed value is reported before half the generation is on disk. Without it, only emptiness is checked.

description.description: What the variable is and where to get its value. Shown to whoever has to fill it in.

runs.description: DE QUE CORRIDAS PARTE. Solo en una generacion de `verifications`. Su presencia es lo que hace que el nucleo ejecute los escenarios y los casos --con las mismas funciones que `ive flow test` y `ive mapping test`-- y deje el RESULTADO en `runs`, dentro del adapter: los dobles salen de lo que el escenario declara y las aserciones de la traza. Una plantilla no vuelve a leer un escenario.

flows.description: Los flows de los que tomar escenarios. Sin declararlo entran todos. Se acota por NOMBRE y no por archivo: un escenario nuevo de un flow ya declarado tiene que entrar solo.

views.description: Las Views con mapeo de las que tomar casos. Sin declararlo entran todas.

fileName.description: Required in practice when scope is 'global' (or a sensible default of '<artifactType>.out' is used).

fileNamePattern.description: Required in practice for perIntent/perFlow/perView/perGroup scopes (uses {IntentName}/{FlowName}/{ViewName}/{GroupName} placeholders accordingly).

reason.description: Why it is excluded. Travels into the facts file as the note of the exclusion.

exclude.description: Names (Intent/Flow/View) to skip for this artifact, even if present in the adapter. A plain string is the name; an object is the same plus the reason.

reason.description: Why it is excluded. Travels into the facts file as the note of the exclusion.

excludePatterns.description: Simple `*` wildcard patterns; a View whose name matches is skipped for this artifact. A plain string is the pattern; an object is the same plus the reason.

onlyOnce.description: Never overwrite the artifact once it exists: it belongs to the project from then on.

onChangeDetected.description: What to do when 'onlyOnce' protected a file and the generated version differs: write <file>.next, warn, or say nothing.

renderLast.description: Render this artifact after every other one. Required for artifacts rendered FROM the collected facts (README, TODO): rendered earlier they see a half-filled list.

filter.description: For scope 'perView': restrict this artifact to Views whose effective 'generation.filterValue' matches. `true` uses the artifact key itself as the value to compare (the common case, where artifact and category share a name); a string compares against that value instead. Absent, the artifact applies to every View not excluded.

excludeFn.description: For scope 'perView' / 'perEntity': name of an already-registered Handlebars helper deciding the exclusion, for logic neither a list nor a pattern can express. Called as helper(view|entity, name, options); returning true excludes it.

oneOf.description: Dotted path resolved against the render root, e.g. 'intentName'.

path.description: Dotted path resolved against the render root.

pattern.description: Regular expression applied to the resolved value; the first capture group is the name, or the whole match when there is none.

helper.description: Name of an already-registered Handlebars helper, called with the same signature as artifactName.

nameFrom.description: Overrides where the artifact's name comes from, for the cases the default naming cannot express. Read by the shared 'artifactName' helper. Opt-in: without it, naming is unchanged.
